name: perrinn_fw_sa
notes: Phase 5 first run: PERRINN 2017 front wing alone, full span, in its on-car position (rake 0.495 deg, lowest point 85.6 mm) over a moving ground, 50 m/s, Spalart-Allmaras (best on the Tyrrell wing validation). Aref = 1 m^2, so Cd/Cl are S.Cd / S.Cl in m^2, comparable with the PERRINN paper's per-component values. No measured reference.
